Subject: Urgent coverage: candidate Anita Shah — IC3 Data Eng loop (slot lift & priority queue)

Hi team,

Quick ask — Anita Shah (resume attached) just moved up to onsite loop for the IC3 Data Engineering role and we lost two panelists due to travel next week. We need to pull together a full loop on June 25 (PST-friendly window).

Current constraint: the candidate is only available 12:00–16:00 PDT on 6/25. The template loop is 4 interviews (system design, infra, data platform coding, behavioral). Can we:
- Identify two replacement interviewers (can be cross-functional)
- Approve one short shadow interviewer to cover swap if someone is late
- Use priority queue / lift mechanism so this loop gets top assignment in the slot matrix

I uploaded an updated slot matrix (panel_slot_matrix_v2.xlsx). I can reassign interview questions to fit a hybrid infra/data split if needed. This is high-propensity (hiring manager expects an offer if loop goes smoothly).

Please reply with availability and any constraints. If we can't fill all roles internally, tag me and I'll reach out to TalentOps to escalate.

Thanks,
Monica
--
Monica Patel
Sr. Hiring Manager, Data Eng
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Urgent coverage: candidate Anita Shah — IC3 Data Eng loop (slot lift & priority queue)

Thanks Monica — pinged a few folks and sketched a quick fallback. Notes below and next steps.

Proposed replacements (can do full interviews on 6/25 12:00–16:00 PDT):
- System design: Karthik Iyer (has prior hiring calibrations for IC3 data)
- Data platform coding: Marissa Cole (strong on data infra, okay to swap in)
- Infra: I can cover infra / reliability questions (shorten to 30m)
- Behavioral: Mon (you) or I suggest a 30m behavioral if we shorten infra to 30m

Shadow: I propose we include a standby/observer (internal only) — Marcus Lin or Ben Carter typically step in, but they are both booked. If Marcus/Ben are out, TalentOps can ask the rotating on-call interviewer pool.

Priority queue: I can mark this loop "priority" in the slot matrix and send a calendar invite with a note asking panelists to confirm within 4 hours. If someone drops, Marissa has agreed to swap into infra or coding depending on preference.

Next steps I can action now:
1) Send calendar invites with the updated split (Karthik, Marissa, Soojin, Monica) and shadow placeholder
2) Add Anita and TalentOps to the invite and attach the loop brief
3) Mark slot-matrix row as "priority: hire" and flag in the internal tracker

If that works, I'll send confirmations and a short pre-loop runbook (who asks what; fallbacks) by EOD.

— Soojin

- If we shorten infra to 30m, I'll prep a two-part question that checks system tradeoffs + data pipeline edge cases
- I added a row in the shared doc noting that I can be primary for coding and backup for infra

Also tagging Karthik: if we need an extra pair of hands on system design for 60m, I can split my time with him and we can coordinate the handoff (30m + 30m).

Marissa
